description:
Add deterministic pattern segmentation over the baseline OSD engine and produce the implementation-level complexity policy.

## Background

Segmentation is optional normal-priority work over exhaustive order-$m$ search. It groups the existing deterministic pattern stream without changing baseline configuration, candidate identity, or previously exported surfaces; the segmentation and complexity-policy types are additive public exports.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Defines deterministic segment boundaries over the existing order-$m$ pattern sequence.
- [hard] REQ-02: Preserves candidate order and result equivalence when segmentation has no active discard threshold.
- [hard] REQ-03: Reports segment, elimination, generated-pattern, and tested-candidate counters with cap plus cancellation termination.
- [hard] REQ-04: Produces the public complexity-policy representation consumed by threshold evaluation.
- [hard] REQ-05: Covers boundary, empty-segment, exact-cap, and cancellation cases in module-local tests.
title: OSD pattern segmentation policy
